name: The Visceral Flinch (Physicalized Anchoring)
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: An opposing party opens with an aggressive, one-sided licensing quote during an in-person meeting.
script: (Lean back physically, exhale audibly, widen eyes, and hold an extended pause) "I... wow. That number is significantly outside the operational bounds we anticipated for this scope."
defense: Neutralize the flinch: name the surprise, then walk the cost model, risk allocations and compliance guarantees.
originFull: Nonverbal Behavioral Signaling and Social Proof prove that expressing shock or disbelief establishes that an offer is wildly outside acceptable social or commercial norms.
defenseFull: Neutralize the flinch immediately: "I recognize that figure was unexpected. Let us walk through the underlying cost models, risk allocations, and compliance guarantees that drive that valuation."
